title: Eylsia Nicolas soars high in new single “I Remember Rising”
htmlContent: Eylsia Nicolas's single is both a testimony and a victory, and it's a way to take back each fall, bruise, and setback that has shaped the life that is now ready for world tours and new opportunities. "I Remember Rising" is based on the deep thought that went into writing her upcoming biography.  The single is built on the highs, the lows, the valleys that build strength, and the unchanging truth that rising has always been the central theme. The song's emotional core isn't in the hardships, but in the grace that kept her going through them. She sees her past not as a painful memory to relive, but as a story of how she has changed.  https://open.spotify.com/track/5xPUo8RXr2RsK2bYp4oYlG "I Remember Rising" combines weakness and strength, and the performance has a grounded, human quality. She is calmly confident that she has already overcome many obstacles and will continue to rise. This release is interesting because it doesn't glorify hardship but does recognize its importance. Nicolas sees her rise as a spiritual journey that she is always on. With upcoming tours, a possible movie adaptation, and an ongoing biography, "I Remember Rising" looks like a turning point in identity. Eylsia Nicolas turns her own story into a song of thanks and strength, guided by grace and strength. Follow Eylsia Nicolas on Facebook and Instagram
